sentences.text: The Environment Agency lists 2 flood warnings and alerts for the London area.
A flood alert covers the Upper River Colne and Radlett Brook.
A further flood alert covers the Lower Lee tributaries.
Today, 2026-11-19, the London forecast is a minimum of 7.2 °C and a maximum of 10.6 °C, with 6.5 mm of rain.
Tomorrow, 2026-11-20, the forecast is a minimum of 6.9 °C and a maximum of 10.2 °C, with 1.1 mm of rain.
Flood monitoring covers 10 stations and 10 rain gauges, last read at 2026-11-19 07:04 UTC.
